tools.name: search_auctions
tools.description: Search auctions on Spain's official BOE portal (judicial foreclosures, notarial and tax-agency auctions) by province, status and asset type.

type.description: Asset type: real estate, vehicles, other goods or all.

tools.name: get_auction_detail
tools.description: Get the full consolidated detail of one auction: general data, managing authority, assets grouped by lot (with per-lot financials), bids, and computed legal award thresholds (art. 671 LEC).

tools.name: calculate_auction_metrics
tools.description: Compute the 50% and 70% reference values and a 5% deposit estimate for a given amount, to evaluate hypotheticals without querying a real auction.

value.description: Positive amount in euros (typically the appraisal value).

tools.name: list_provinces
tools.description: List the 52 Spanish provinces with their numeric code, needed for the province filter of search_auctions.
